description: This file defines the WebKit class, a specialized subclass of BrowserType, providing functionality for connecting and configuring a WebKit browser within the Playwright testing framework. It includes methods for connecting via transport, modifying environment variables, rewriting startup logs, graceful shutdown, and preparing launch arguments specific to WebKit. It also contains a utility function for translating file paths to WSL format.
